# Lion Tech Innovations Ltd

> Lion Tech Innovations Ltd is a Manchester-based AI Business Readiness company serving UK businesses remotely. It helps businesses see what leading AI systems currently say, review the evidence, and fix priority gaps.

Website: https://liontechinnovations.co.uk
Contact: contact@liontechinnovations.co.uk
Service area: UK-based, serving businesses remotely
Company number: 17068390
Companies House: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/17068390

## Primary service

- AI Visibility Snapshot: https://liontechinnovations.co.uk/ai-visibility-snapshot
  - £395 founding price and £495 standard price after the first 10 clients
  - Buyer-intent tests across leading AI systems, with competitor benchmarking
  - Evidence-led report, Five Gates Readiness Profile, top five fixes and 30-day action plan
  - 48-hour delivery after completed onboarding and business verification
  - Minimum-5 Guarantee: if LionTech cannot identify at least five concrete, evidenced inaccuracies, omissions, competitor gaps or actionable readiness improvements in the agreed sampled tests, the Snapshot fee is refunded

## Five Gates Method

1. Discover
2. Describe
3. Trust
4. Compare
5. Act
